news.headline: Audric Estimé goes on injured reserve
news.summary: The Saints put running back Audric Estimé on injured reserve Saturday, so he will miss at least the first four games. They also signed tight end Treyton Welch and moved up receiver Kevin Austin Jr. and running back CJ Donaldson from the practice squad for Sunday at Detroit.

news.headline: Tyler Shough starts his second season as a captain
news.summary: Quarterback Tyler Shough is the starter again this year, and his teammates voted him one of the team captains. He now gives the speech in the huddle before games, a job Drew Brees used to have.

news.headline: Cam Jordan is out Sunday, Kamara is a maybe
news.summary: The Saints ruled out Cam Jordan, tight end Oscar Delp and running back Audric Estime for Sunday's opener at Detroit. Alvin Kamara is listed as questionable after he practiced fully on Friday.

news.headline: SEC meets but takes no vote on LSU
news.summary: The league's school presidents met by video call Thursday and did not vote on LSU's membership. The SEC said afterward only that the talks will keep going.

news.headline: SEC not expected to vote on removing LSU
news.summary: LSU filled its last two roster spots and told the conference the matter was closed, so the vote is off the agenda for Thursday's meeting. The two former pro players LSU wanted to add cannot join the team this season.

news.headline: LSU tells the SEC it has followed the rules
news.summary: LSU wrote to the conference on Wednesday and said the matter is settled, one day before the league's school presidents meet about it. LSU also said it will not try to stop that meeting.

news.headline: Tulane wears Mardi Gras uniforms Saturday night
news.summary: Tulane plays South Alabama at home Saturday night in green, purple and gold uniforms made for Mardi Gras. The helmet shows the Angry Wave in a jester hat with beads around it, and the back of the helmet reads "Uptown."

news.headline: Tulane names a new starting quarterback
news.summary: Coach Will Hall said Tuesday that Kadin Semonza will start Saturday against South Alabama. Semonza came off the bench at halftime at Duke and led Tulane's only scoring drive.

news.headline: Tulane's coach says the mistakes can be fixed
news.summary: Will Hall took the blame for the offense after Saturday's 17-3 loss at Duke. Tulane was flagged for 15 penalties, and Hall changed quarterbacks at halftime.
